subject: Edgeware Systems — Onsite visit: lab suite access & NDA
messages:
From: Alex Weber <a.weber@edgeware.io>
To: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Cc: Edgeware Systems Events <events@edgeware.io>
Date: Wed, 1 Sep 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Onsite visit request — lab suite access and NDA

Hi Olga / Marcus,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the team at Edgeware is excited to get a deeper, in-person look at the lab suite and the GPU setup. We proposed coming to Redwood HQ the week of Sept 13. Can we do a half-day visit (9:30–13:30) focused on:

- brief intro and goals (30m)
- walkthrough of lab/demo cluster and AV (60m)
- tabletop integration session (60m)
- time for ops/security Q&A (30m)

We’re happy to sign whatever visitor NDA is required — attaching a signed copy of our standard NDA for your records. Also, can we confirm whether guests can bring laptops and if there’s a preferred parking/visitor flow?

Attaching: Edgeware_NDA_signed.pdf

Thanks,
Alex
Director of Integrations
Edgeware Systems
[Attachment: Edgeware_NDA_signed.pdf (PDF, 240 KB)]

From: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>
To: Alex Weber <a.weber@edgeware.io>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 1 Sep 2027 12:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Onsite visit request — lab suite access and NDA

Alex — great to hear, and thanks for sending the signed NDA. We’d love to host you. Quick notes and ask: 

1) We can do Sept 14 or Sept 15 9:30–13:30. Which works for your team?
2) Guests are allowed to bring laptops; for the lab they will need temporary network access (we’ll provision guest VLANs). Please provide attendee names 48 hours in advance for badging.
3) We’ll reserve the Lab Suite (Room G2) and the adjacent Collaboration Room. I’m looping in Neha (ops) to handle room setup and Marcus for the technical run-of-show.

I attached the latest lab floorplan and our visitor guidelines — please review and confirm attendee names. Once you confirm date and attendee list we’ll send a calendar invite and guest badges.

Attachments: hq-lab-suite-floorplan-v3.png, visitor_guidelines.pdf

Best,
Olga
Sr. Partnerships Manager | Redwood Inference
[Attachment: hq-lab-suite-floorplan-v3.png (PNG, 480 KB)]
[Attachment: visitor_guidelines.pdf (PDF, 120 KB)]

From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 1 Sep 2027 14:20:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Onsite visit request — lab suite access and NDA

Olga / Marcus — on logistics:

- I can reserve Lab Suite G2 and Collaboration Room C1 for Sept 14 and 15 (prefilled provisional). Recommend Sept 14 to keep your week open.
- AV: will deploy the demo rig in G2; bring any USB-C adapters.
- Networking: guest VLAN w/ limited egress; need attendee names + device MACs 24 hrs before for temporary whitelist OR we can provide preconfigured loaner laptops from the Lab.
- Catering: light coffee + boxed lunches — confirm headcount.

I’ll prepare a badge packet and escort schedule once names are final. Marcus — can you confirm you’ll be onsite to run the cluster demo at 10:15?

—Neha
Head of Facility Ops
[Attachment: room_setup_checklist.xlsx (XLSX, 35 KB)]

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>, Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 2 Sep 2027 09:00:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Onsite visit request — lab suite access and NDA

On Thu, Sep 1, 2027 at 2:20 PM Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com> wrote:
> Olga / Marcus — on logistics:
> 
> - I can reserve Lab Suite G2 and Collaboration Room C1 for Sept 14 and 15 (prefilled provisional). Recommend Sept 14 to keep your week open.
> - AV: will deploy the demo rig in G2; bring any USB-C adapters.

Thanks — I’ll be there Sept 14, can run the cluster demo and the integration tabletop. Proposed run-of-show:

09:30 — Welcome & intro (Olga + Alex)
10:00 — HW/cluster walkthrough (Marcus)
11:15 — Integration tabletop: sample API flows + KV cache demo (Marcus + Alex)
12:15 — Ops/security Q&A (Neha + Marcus)
12:45 — Wrap / next steps

I’ll bring one loaner laptop and the prebuilt environment image. Olga — can you ask Edgeware for the final attendee list by Tue 12th EOD?

—Marcus
Senior Software Engineer, Field Ops

From: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>
To: Alex Weber <a.weber@edgeware.io>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 3 Sep 2027 10:15:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Onsite visit request — lab suite access and NDA

Alex — thanks for confirming. Sept 14 is locked. Calendar invite sent (link below). Please send a list of attendees (full name + email + company) by Tue, Sept 12 EOD so badges and guest WLAN can be provisioned.

Provisional details: 
- Date: Tue, Sept 14, 2027
- Time: 09:30–13:30 PT
- Location: Redwood HQ, Lab Suite G2 (check-in at Reception, 1st floor)
- Parking: Visitor lot P2 — please display permit code: RW-EDGE-142
- Run-of-show: as discussed (Marcus will lead cluster demo at ~10:00)

Attachments: visitor_guidelines.pdf, hq-lab-suite-floorplan-v3.png

Calendar: https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=edgeware-hq-20270910
Drive prep folder: https://drive.redwood.com/Edgeware/Onsite-Prep/Visitor-Checklist

Looking forward — safe travels to your team.

Best,
Olga
Sr. Partnerships Manager | Redwood Inference
[Attachment: visitor_guidelines.pdf (PDF, 120 KB)]
